controls.boundary: all-PRN coherent false path is structurally K1 and must not be tuned into a positive

dynamic_panel.drop_add: allowed when epoch gate and fit-eligibility rules remain satisfied
dynamic_panel.eligible_prn_fit_rule: at least four fit epochs with code and at least four fit epochs with Doppler or carrier; heldout-only new PRNs excluded from both K1 and K2 heldout likelihood
dynamic_panel.missing_values: evaluate each finite modality independently; one NaN never rejects a complete window
dynamic_panel.representation: union-of-PRNs tensor plus per-epoch/per-PRN/per-modality valid mask
dynamic_panel.window_epoch_gate: at every epoch at least five PRNs have at least code plus one dynamic modality

geometry.apparent_range_rate_mps: centered 0.5 s derivative of apparent range with receiver-position linear interpolation
geometry.broadcast_ephemeris: Galileo RINEX 3 navigation, closest healthy record for the same satellite with |t-Toe|<=7200 s
geometry.earth_rotation: rotate transmit-time satellite ECEF around z by omega_E*rho/c (Sagnac), two fixed-point iterations
geometry.fit_only_nuisance: subtract each eligible PRN's fit-interval median code residual and median dynamic residual; never use heldout values
geometry.orbit: Galileo broadcast Kepler model; solve eccentric anomaly to 1e-13 rad; harmonic corrections; velocity by centered 0.5 s finite difference
geometry.receiver_position: GNSS-SDR GPX latitude/longitude/ellipsoidal-height converted to WGS84 ECEF and linearly interpolated at RINEX epochs; maximum alignment error 1.0 s
geometry.satellite_clock: af0+af1*dt+af2*dt^2+F*e*sqrt(A)*sin(E), I/NAV clock model; record applied=True
geometry.signal_bias: no additional BGD for E1B I/NAV clock model; record applied=False and preserve as per-PRN constant nuisance removed by fit-only centering

implementation_freeze_rule: only data-independent synthetic unit tests before implementation freeze; exactly one C-1/C-3 execution after push

model.K1: one shared clock state path for every eligible PRN
model.K2: two state paths plus one fixed soft membership probability per eligible PRN for the whole window
model.canonicalization: ascending fitted clock-range path mean over fit epochs; never satellite ID or synthetic truth
model.estimator: Student-t IRLS MAP state-space smoothing nested in deterministic soft EM
model.initialization: three deterministic fit-only restarts: neutral 0.5 membership and +/- SVD fit-residual summaries; SVD/hard grouping is initialization only
model.restart_selection: maximum fit Student-t likelihood only; heldout inaccessible until selected model is frozen
model.shared_contract: K1/K2 share fit-only modality scales, censoring, valid mask, eligible PRNs, process covariance, and heldout observations
model.soft_assignment: E-step uses per-PRN fit likelihood and equal prior; clip probabilities to [1e-6,1-1e-6]

cadence.native_trace_cadence_source: parse every native TRACE header coherent_integration_s; cross-check consecutive raw_interval_start_sample deltas and frozen output manifest

observable_contract.sign_pass: all three correlations >= 0.90 independently in C-1 and C-3

score.delta_p: 2 + M_eligible (one additional two-state initial condition plus one soft-membership logit per eligible PRN)
score.heldout_policy: prediction only from fit terminal states and fixed assignments; no heldout filtering, fitting, initialization, restart, centering, or scale estimation

split.C-1: after initial guard, first at most 80 chronological epochs for scale/process/state fitting only
split.C-3: after initial guard let N be usable length; calibration=floor((N-10)/2), then 10 epoch guard, then untouched remainder holdout
split.limited_duration_rule: if independent calibration blocks <20, never claim publication-grade FPR; READY must state PROVISIONAL_LIMITED_DURATION
split.stable_start: first epoch of first continuous M>=5 run lasting at least 60 s
split.threshold: q99 method='higher' over calibration non-overlapping 10-epoch block maxima; persistence=3 consecutive score exceedances
split.zero_false_alarm_ci: two-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound reported for holdout persistent-decision count

synthetic.injection: code += d0*I(t=onset)+v*t+0.5*a*t^2 accumulated trajectory; carrier increment += delta(trajectory) including d0 once at onset transition; Doppler residual += v+a*t
synthetic.onsets: three frozen valid chronological onsets at 0%, 33%, 66% of allowable support, each with >=30 post-onset epochs
synthetic.subset_selection: SHA256 ordering of audit-only satellite IDs with fixed seed; IDs never enter model
